This StateTree Task changes some Character Movement Component properties on the owning character. It's useful to have the character move with different properties while a given state is active.

NOTE: it won't restore the Character Movement Comp to its original values! Instead it will set them to the On Exit values. Keep this in mind if your character still moves differently after the state ends.
